capabilities.description: One Story and Acceptance Criterion identity moves from planning authority to repository authority.
capabilities.name: Lifecycle-aware authority

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must allow planning writers to create and revise only backlog Stories and their Acceptance Criteria.

stories.benefit: intent can mature without pretending it is accepted behavior
stories.goal: refine Stories and Acceptance Criteria while they remain in the backlog
stories.title: Shape behavior before implementation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must preserve matching planning Story and Acceptance Criterion identities when a repository contract is synchronized.

scenarios.given: planning changes after a materializing branch was created
scenarios.then: Tieline must project the merged definition and preserve the later planning revision as a handoff conflict
scenarios.when: the reviewed repository definition is synchronized

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must keep read, planning-write, repository-sync, and offline-admin database responsibilities separate.

stories.benefit: stable identity survives delivery without two writers
stories.goal: materialize planning definitions with the implementation
stories.title: Transfer accepted behavior to repository authority

capabilities.description: Accepted product behavior is strict, reviewable, and measurable beside the implementation.
capabilities.name: Living product contract

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must reject repository contract documents that violate the accepted Story and Acceptance Criterion schema.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Structural failures make semantic impact and synchronization untrustworthy.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must compile deterministic manifests and report direct-AC and repository mapping coverage with explicit gaps.

scenarios.given: ten eligible source files and eight mapped paths
scenarios.then: Tieline must report 80 percent coverage and name both unmapped files

scenarios.given: configured source roots contain no eligible files
scenarios.then: Tieline must report that coverage is not measured instead of reporting 100 percent

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must report affected Acceptance Criteria and freshness for changed, renamed, or deleted linked paths without blocking on semantic findings.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Drift should be visible during review while the MVP remains warn-only.

scenarios.given: a linked implementation path changes without a refreshed manifest
scenarios.then: Tieline must report the linked criterion as impacted and stale
scenarios.when: the branch is checked against its base

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must render accepted Stories and Acceptance Criteria as a self-contained human-readable review page.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Maintainers outside the implementation can review the same repository-owned contract accepted by the pull request.

stories.benefit: intent and implementation change through the same review
stories.goal: define product behavior in a stable Story and Acceptance Criterion hierarchy
stories.title: Review accepted behavior with code

capabilities.description: Requests, bugs, questions, optional work, and help content remain distinct from accepted behavior.
capabilities.name: Evidence and planning intake

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must append an Observation before semantic matching and allow it to remain unattributed.

scenarios.then: Tieline must return the stored record for a later matching retry
scenarios.when: an Observation has already been stored

stories.benefit: source evidence is never lost or forced into an incorrect feature
stories.goal: record a request, bug, or question without first finding a product definition
stories.title: Preserve source observations before attribution

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must let a Backlog Item target zero or more Stories and Acceptance Criteria without becoming their lifecycle container.

stories.benefit: planning work remains separate from the product contract
stories.goal: group evidence and target existing or future behavior
stories.title: Consolidate optional work without duplicating behavior

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must resolve help content by source and external identifier while preserving Story and Acceptance Criterion backlinks.

stories.benefit: accepted behavior can point to documentation maintained elsewhere
stories.goal: ingest and retrieve help content by its source identity
stories.title: Connect external help without copying its identity

capabilities.description: Focused semantic documents and auditable suggestions help equivalent language converge.
capabilities.name: Semantic matching and consolidation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must derive separate semantic documents for Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Scenarios, Backlog Items, and sanitized Observations.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Focused documents preserve specificity and avoid re-embedding unrelated criteria.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must apply retrieval metadata as narrowing filters before combining always-on full-text and identifier recall with optional vector, alias, artifact-overlap, and three-hop graph signals through reciprocal rank fusion.

scenarios.given: no embedding provider is installed or reachable
scenarios.then: Tieline must return full-text or identifier matches with explicit signal features and match reasons
scenarios.when: a caller searches with an authorized retrieval profile

scenarios.given: a caller supplies an Observation anchor with only a dismissed relationship to an Acceptance Criterion
scenarios.then: the dismissed relationship must contribute no graph proximity
scenarios.when: Tieline ranks the authorized semantic candidate set

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must keep similarity-only relationships suggested until an explicit decision confirms or dismisses them.

scenarios.given: a high-scoring semantic match without an explicit human decision

stories.benefit: alternate phrasing converges without deleting source history
stories.goal: find equivalent Stories, Acceptance Criteria, work, and evidence
stories.title: Search before creating product or planning records

capabilities.description: Callers retrieve exact or semantic business context without confusing production truth and planning material.
capabilities.name: Intent-aware organization search

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must return structured Stories with ordered Acceptance Criteria, direct and fallback links, coverage, freshness, lifecycle, and authority.

stories.benefit: answers stay grounded in the most specific known contract
stories.goal: inspect behavior with its evidence and state
stories.title: Retrieve Stories through their Acceptance Criteria

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must resolve a versioned retrieval profile before cross-type search and allow caller filters only to narrow it.

scenarios.given: the support profile excludes planning authority
scenarios.then: Tieline must search only the repository intersection
scenarios.when: a caller requests both planning and repository authority

stories.benefit: the result state is clear without permanently hiding useful records
stories.goal: choose production, engineering, discovery, or full authorized context
stories.title: Select an explicit retrieval intent

capabilities.description: Tieline initializes, serves, and composes its contract capabilities without leaking privileged writers into read paths.
capabilities.name: Portable and safe operation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must keep shared repository configuration portable while storing clone-local setup state and database credentials in a private external profile.
Tieline must report workspace initialization, clone-local setup, and database-backed capability configuration as separate states.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: A tracked config cannot prove that another clone has credentials or semantic matching available.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must surface detected source roots and preflight warnings while leaving the specification empty until repository-specific semantic onboarding.

stories.benefit: the repository remains shareable without committing secrets
stories.goal: configure contract roots and private runtime credentials
stories.title: Initialize a portable Tieline workspace

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must compose read, evidence-write, and planning-write capabilities without exposing repository synchronization through MCP tools.
Tieline must serve stdio by default and require explicit gateway configuration for non-loopback HTTP.
Tieline must provide a loud in-memory test seam for contract and tool verification without weakening production adapters.
Tieline must expose a semantic-authoring prompt that uses configured repository context and falls back to disclosed local duplicate checks when database-backed matching is unavailable.

stories.benefit: tool capabilities match their database authority
stories.goal: use a focused contract, search, evidence, and planning interface
stories.title: Serve lifecycle-aware tools through MCP

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tieline must run the clean lifecycle integration suite against a disposable baseline database.

stories.benefit: clean installations prove the shared contract end to end
stories.goal: exercise evidence, planning, authority transfer, profiles, and the baseline together
stories.title: Verify the lifecycle as one system
